title: catpart-inspect output, schema v1
description: Version-1 report emitted by `catpart-inspect <file>` (ticket #23). Supersedes v0 (ticket #11): the container list is now the parsed container-name table records of docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md instead of v0's whole-file string scan (the v0 field container_names is dropped; that breaking change is why the version bumped), and the file metadata adds the part/product kind, the remaining header dwords and the trailer. Every field cites the evidence note and byte ranges that justify it; values whose semantics are unproven are reported as-is. Evolution is additive within a schema version: consumers must ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bumped only by a breaking output change; additive changes keep the version.

magic.description: ASCII decoding of header bytes 0-8 with trailing NUL bytes stripped: 'V5_CFV2' on well-formed files (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-triage.md, bytes 0-8). Reported as observed, not verified: 6 corpus files are known to carry a different magic.

header_dword.description: Big-endian uint32 at header bytes 8-12 (dword8). Always below file size in the Phase 1 corpus (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-triage.md, bytes 8-12). Per the tail-region law H1 (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md) it is the start offset of the CATIA_V5 CB0001 tail region on CB__END-ending files; reported as-is.

header_dword12.description: Big-endian uint32 at header bytes 12-16 (dword12). On CB__END-ending files it equals the tail-region length and trailer G (law H1, 1556/1556 corpus files; docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md). Never 0xFFFFFFFF (0/1818 Phase 1 files).

ff8_at_16_24.description: True when header bytes 16-24 are eight 0xFF bytes (1672/1818 Phase 1 files, docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-triage.md). False marks the dual-region variant (146 files, docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md, 'The 146 files without ff x8'): a different writer generation whose header continues as two more big-endian dwords.

header_dword16.description: Big-endian uint32 at header bytes 16-20 of the dual-region variant (offset of an additional CATIA_V5 CB0001 region in 143/146 dual-region files, docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md). Null when ff8_at_16_24 is true (the bytes are the ff x8 marker, not a dword).

header_dword20.description: Big-endian uint32 at header bytes 20-24 of the dual-region variant. Null when ff8_at_16_24 is true. Semantics unproven (open question in docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md); reported as-is.

detected_version.description: Release marker (V5RxxSPxxHFxx) detected from the embedded CNEXTINFOS string (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-triage.md, 'Per-file version marker'): 8 KB window first, 64 KB fallback, 'unknown' when no marker is present (map decision on ticket #4; 338/1818 corpus files).

kind.description: Part/product kind from the container-name table records (law K1, docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-kind-law.md): 'part' when a record is named CATPrtCont, 'product' when CATProdCont or CATMechProdCont is named and CATPrtCont is not, 'unknown' otherwise (no table, or a table carrying neither name - 0/1810 with-table corpus files).

name.description: The container's own name (record field name1, bytes S+40 to the first NUL): printable ASCII.

parent_name.description: The record's parent/base name (record field name2, second NUL-terminated string): corpus vocabulary led by CATContainer, CATFeatCont, CATProdCont (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md).

table_id.description: Record field f3 at S+8 (little-endian): exactly three values corpus-wide (19300/19300 records) - 0x00030001 (196609) container rows, 0x00040001 (262145) the AppliCont row, 0x00050001 (327681) observed on some files.

index.description: Record field idx at S+12 (little-endian): 1-based index within the table id; skips observed.

stream_id.description: Record field f1 at S+0 (little-endian): stream-position value; the join key with the (unparsed) directory table (law D1, docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md).

weight.description: Record field f2 at S+4 (little-endian): per-record weight (11/12/13/21 observed; semantics unproven); feeds the directory cumulative law D2.

guid.description: The record's 16-byte GUID (bytes S+names_area+8 .. +24 of the record), lowercase hex; per-record object id.

containers.description: The parsed container-name table records, in file order (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md: records located by the f9 anchor 0x20810002 at S+32 and fully validated against the record model - laws T1/T3 - before being reported; the scan covers the evidence-validated first 2 MB window). Empty for the 8 corpus files with no table.

a.description: Big-endian uint32 at file size - 36: constant 0x00000001 on every CB__END-ending corpus file (1556/1556, docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md).

registration_offset.description: Trailer field B (big-endian uint32 at file size - 32): absolute file offset of the writer registration block (byte-proven: it moves by exactly the size delta between near-identical saves; docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md).

c.description: Trailer field C (big-endian uint32 at file size - 28): first half of the C==D pair, stored twice, value file-dependent (0x000000e7 is the mode); semantics unproven, reported as-is.

d.description: Trailer field D (big-endian uint32 at file size - 24): second half of the C==D pair; equals C on every CB__END-ending corpus file (1556/1556).

e.description: Trailer field E (big-endian uint32 at file size - 20): 0 on 1555/1556 CB__END-ending files (the one exception is a dual-region file). Reported as-is, not invariant-enforced.

f.description: Trailer field F (big-endian uint32 at file size - 16): 0 (1378 files), 1 (177), 2 (1); semantics unproven, reported as-is.

tail_region_length.description: Trailer field G (big-endian uint32 at file size - 12): equals header dword12 == file size - header_dword8 (law H1, 1556/1556 CB__END-ending files) - the length of the CATIA_V5 CB0001 tail region.

tag.description: The registration block's tag byte, 0x4d or 0x4e, as a single character ('M'/'N'); per B1, 0x4e on most R15-R18 and R21 files, 0x4d on most R19/R20 and R23+. Meaning unproven.

company.description: First length-prefixed (u32le) string of the block, byte-exact by validation.

product.description: Second length-prefixed (u32le) string of the block, byte-exact by validation.

code.description: Third length-prefixed (u32le) string of the block; identical across all observed versions (not the writing release; meaning unproven).

registration.description: The writer registration block at registration_offset, reported only when it matches the documented byte pattern ([tag 0x4d|0x4e][u32le 17]"DASSAULT-SYSTEMES"[u32le 5]"CATIA"[u32le 6]"041803"; 1553/1556 CB__END-ending files, docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md); null when the offset is out of range or the bytes differ.

trailer.description: The file trailer (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-table-and-trailer.md): the last 36 bytes of a file ending with CB__END\0 - seven big-endian dwords plus the 8-byte marker. Null when the file does not end with CB__END\0 (262/1818 corpus files, including all dual-region files without a CB__END tail) or is shorter than 36 bytes.
